solution: Identify the opposite and adjacent sides and the hypotenuse with reference to the given angle: Remember that the hypotenuse side is always opposite the right angle, it never changes position. Rearrange the equation to solve for: $\begin{align*}\sin50^{\circ}\times100&=\frac{x}{100}\times100\\\sin50^{\circ}\times100&=x\\x&=100\sin50^{\circ}\end{align*}$
Use your calculator to find the answer: $\begin{align*}x&=\text{76,60444...}\\x&\approx\text{76,60}\end{align*}$
